How Long Should You Stay in a Sauna?

Stay in a sauna for about 15 to 20 minutes per session, and start with 5 to 10 minutes if you are new. Traditional saunas usually run 150 to 195°F and infrared saunas 110 to 150°F, and a long Finnish study linked using one 4 to 7 times a week with lower rates of fatal heart disease.
